table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	Today=GETDATE(),
	RefusedSaleInvCode=T.RefusedSaleInvCode,   
	RefusalDate = T.RefusalDate,
	SaleInvCode=T.SaleInvCode,   
	I.customicode, 
	itemname= CASE WHEN I.name IS NULL THEN T.UnKnownItemName ELSE I.name END, 
	packingdesc=I.packingdesc,
	ReasonCode=T.Reasoncode,
	UnKnownItemName=T.UnKnownItemName,
	icode=T.icode,   
	ROWID=T.RowID,
	looseqty= T.looseqty,
	saleqty = T.SaleQty,
	Balance = T.looseqty - T.SaleQty,
	LastSaleDate = T.LastSaleDate,
	LastSaleInvCode= T.LastSaleInvCode,
	RefusalDays = CAST(DATEDIFF(n, T.RefusalDate, ISNULL(T.LastSaleDate, GETDATE())) / 1440 AS INT),
	RefusalHours = CAST(DATEDIFF(n, T.RefusalDate, ISNULL(T.LastSaleDate, GETDATE())) % 1440 / 60 AS INT),
	RefusalMin = CAST((DATEDIFF(n, T.RefusalDate, ISNULL(T.LastSaleDate, GETDATE())) % 1440) % 60 AS INT)
FROM
	(SELECT 
		RefusalDate = RSH.Date,
		RefusedSaleInvCode=RSD.RefusedSaleInvCode,   
		SaleInvCode=RSH.SaleInvCode,   
		icode=RSD.ICode,   
		ReasonCode=RSD.ReasonCode,
		UnKnownItemName=RSD.UnKnownItemName,
		RowID=RSD.IDENTITYCOL,
		looseqty= RSD.Qty,
		saleqty = ISNULL(sum(SD.LooseQty), 0),
		LastSaleDate = (SELECT SH.Date FROM SaleLedger SH WHERE SH.SaleinvCode IN (MAX(SD.SaleInvCode)) ),
		LastSaleInvCode=MAX(SD.SaleInvCode)
	FROM
		RefusedSaleDetail RSD LEFT OUTER JOIN SaleDetail AS SD ON (RSD.rowid = SD.RefusalSaleRowID), 
		RefusedSaleHeader RSH
	WHERE 
		RSH.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND
		RSH.RefusedSaleInvCode = RSD.RefusedSaleInvCode AND
		SD.RefusalSaleRowID > 0
	GROUP BY
		RSH.Date,
		RSD.RefusedSaleInvCode,   
		RSH.SaleInvCode,   
		RSD.icode,   
		RSD.Reasoncode,
		RSD.UnKnownItemName,
		RSD.IDENTITYCOL,
		RSD.qty) AS T LEFT OUTER JOIN Item I ON (T.ICode = I.ICode)
table.sort: refusaldate A, refusedsaleinvcode A, itemname A
